jobs.title: Product Manager E-Invoicing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Warum Wir? Bei uns erwarten Dich weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams, flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, die zum Mitgestalten einlädt. Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns zum Alltag. Möchtest Du Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens werden, dessen Lösung den Arbeitsalltag in unterschiedlichsten Branchen digitalisiert? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!

 Das erwartet Dich Als Product Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Anbindung von DocuWare an Netzwerke zum Austausch von e-Invoices in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, UX- und Compliance-Spezialisten. Gemeinsam stellt Ihr sicher, dass DocuWare die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an den Austausch von elektronischen Rechnungen erfüllt. Dabei behältst Du die regulatorischen Anforderungen und Zeitpläne im Blick und hilfst unseren Kunden, diese mit DocuWare zu erfüllen. 

Du kannst dich in die Lage unserer Anwenderinnen und Anwender versetzen und ihre Probleme und täglichen Aufgaben nachvollziehen? Du bist neugierig, arbeitest gerne lösungsorientiert und im Team, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und bist ein Organisationstalent? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennen zu lernen! 
Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören: Du verfolgst die Entwicklungen und Anforderungen für e-Invoicing in und außerhalb Europa in Zusammenarbeit mit externen und internen Compliance-Spezialisten.
 Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen und Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden.
 Du agierst dabei kundenzentriert, holst Kundenfeedback ein und analysierst Daten, um die richtigen Entscheidungen abzuleiten.
 Du formulierst präzise Anforderung zu den Kundenproblemen und -bedürfnissen.
 Du entwirfst die kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Strategie und Roadmap für Deinen Bereich unseres Produkts und führst das Team mit Zielen und KPIs.
 Du prägst eine konstruktive und integrative Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Produktteams und agierst als Teamschnittstelle zu Stakeholdern.
 Du arbeitest eng mit Softwareentwicklern und UX-Spezialisten an der Implementierung des Produktes im Rahmen des SCRUM-Frameworks zusammen.
 

 Das bringst Du mit Du verfügst über breites und tiefes Wissen im Bereich e-Invoicing.
 Die Begriffe XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, FatturaPA und Factur-X sind für Dich keine Unbekannten.
 Du kannst die Unterschiede zwischen PEPPOL, SDI, Chorus Pro und FACe in wenigen Worten verständlich erklären.
 Du hast Erfahrung als Produktmanager für Software-Produkte. Erfahrung mit B2B Software ist ein Plus.
 Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem agilen Umfeld (beispielsweise als SCRUM Product Owner).
 Du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Endnutzern und der Lösungsgestaltung anhand deren Bedürfnissen.
 Du verfügst über ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten, arbeitest zielorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.
 Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich darzulegen.
 Eine Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Teamfähigkeit zeichnen Dich aus.
 Fließende Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
 

 Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Es gibt viele gute Gründe für DocuWare – unsere Unternehmenskultur ist nur einer davon.  Im Team von DocuWare profitierst auch Du von diesen Vorteilen: Weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams: Du triffst uns in Germering, New York, Sofia oder vielen anderen Locations.
 Flexibler Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit: Du arbeitest mobil oder in unserem modernen und gut ausgestattetem Büro – dabei teilst Du Dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel ein.
 Individuelle Förderung: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung bekommst Du regelmäßig auf Dich zugeschnittene Weiterbildungen (u.a. Kongresse, interne Teambuilding Maßnahmen).
 Wohl verdiente Erholung: Neben 35 Urlaubstagen im Jahr bieten wir Dir ein breites Sport- und Massageangebot, Kicker-Tisch und einen entspannenden Lounge-Bereich.
 Gesunde Ernährung: Zusammen genießen wir Fairtrade Kaffee mit Bio-Milch oder HaferDrink, Snacks und frisches Obst – alles kostenlos – sowie bezuschussten Lunch aus dem Foodji-Kühlschrank.

jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
jobs.description:
Welcome to baramundi! “Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”
 
Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features. 

 Do what you do best: DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
 TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
 DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
 BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
 COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
 USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.
 

 What we appreciate about you: Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
 Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
 Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
 Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
 Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.
 Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality.
 Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
 Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.
 Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS.
 

 Meet us! 

 10 reasons to choose baramundi! #1 ARRIVE IN PEACE 
Our all-inclusive package makes starting particularly easy. Your personal onboarding buddy will show you everything: from the welcome breakfast to the fully equipped workplace.

 #2 FEEL AT HOME 
Coffee, fruit, and drinks are free. We take care of your mail and packages. Once a month, all baramundians meet during work hours for pizza and chatting. Just because.

 #3 EXPERIENCE VALUE AND APPRECIATION 
We believe in values and live them: togetherness and trust. Courage, enthusiasm, and competence. Our communication culture is open and honest. Just like the regular team feedback sessions.

 #4 GET REWARDED 
You will also feel our appreciation. Success bonuses are as natural as Christmas bonuses, company pension plans, and team events.

 #5 ENJOY LIFE 
Work time is life time. That’s why you can organize it individually with us. With flexible work

jobs.title: Product Manager (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
jobs.description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3) 
 The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.
 They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.
 Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.
 Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own.
 
 What you'll do
 As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for empowering developers and designers to solve customer problems. You will work directly with our SVP Product Engineering Daniel .
 You will:
 Shape company and product strategy alongside our SVP of Product Engineering. It's a genuine partnership: you'll develop the vision for where Checkly goes next, decide where we play in the AI testing, monitoring, and observability landscape and where we don't, and turn that into a direction. You build the strategy with us, not execute someone else's.

 Shape Checkly's point of view on reliability in an AI-native world: how teams monitor AI-generated code, agent-driven workflows, and LLM-backed features

 Lead initiatives across Product Engineering, Sales and Marketing, and represent Checkly directly to customers and in developer communities.

 Live in the product and the problem. Empathy for DevOps, SRE and Platform Engineering isn't a line item. It's the job.

 You ship with AI where it helps and know when not to. You don't just talk about it.

 
 What you should have
 You've built software before this. You're an ex-engineer, ex-founder, or ex-solutions engineer who has written real code and shipped real things, and now you want to own the product. This one's non-negotiable: you should be able to reason about APIs, MCPs, CLIs, and how systems fit together without a translator.

 You've worked in a startup, not just a big company. You're comfortable with ambiguity, small teams, and owning outcomes end to end. You don't need a big-company machine around you to be effective.

 You've built technical products, ideally developer tools. Adjacent technical products count. Experience in monitoring or observability is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

 New to the PM title? That's fine. If you're coming from a founding or solutions-engineering seat and want to go all-in on product, we want to hear from you.

 You're technical enough to be dangerous with AI tooling. You can prototype in code, throw together a mock, or pressure-test technical viability yourself when it moves things forward.

 FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. Need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment.

 We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.
 We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

 We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

 We are lean, so you own the boring parts too. There is no PM ops layer to delegate the unglamorous work to. You will do strategy one hour and clean up a messy spec the next.

 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
 Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
 Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
 We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

 Our AI product area is growing. We already have two Product Managers working across conversational AI, agentic workflows, and domain-specific automation, and we need a third to expand our capacity as the scope of AI at 9fin accelerates.

 You will join an established AI PM team and take ownership of a product area within our AI surface. This could span new AI-powered features for credit analysts, workflow automation for legal and financial analysis, or expanding our conversational AI into new domains. The team has already built evaluation infrastructure and quality frameworks; you will use and contribute to these rather than build them from scratch.
 You will work within our product organization (eight squads across AI, data, and domain verticals) and partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, domain experts, and designers. This is a high-autonomy role with real scope to shape what 9fin's AI products can do for our clients.
  
 What You'll Do
  
 Product Strategy & Execution
 Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for your area, with a focus on building and evolving our AI products

 Synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into problem statements that identify root causes, not just symptoms

 Demonstrate a working understanding of the challenges specific to building with LLMs, including managing hallucinations, evaluating output quality, and designing for non-deterministic systems

 Proactively identify and track metrics that measure client and business benefit, working with the team on continuous model evaluation and improvement

 Work with data scientists and ML engineers to bridge the gap between business needs and the technical capabilities of AI models

 Communicate strategy, initiatives, and progress transparently across the organisation

 Translate complex AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations into language that non-technical stakeholders can act on

 Champion responsible AI practices: transparency in model outputs, bias monitoring, and compliance with client expectations around AI-generated content

We’re Heidi. 
 We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

 Make pre-screening safe to trust. Turn complex inclusion and exclusion criteria into workflows that are explainable, reviewable and obvious to a coordinator under time pressure.

 Ship with design and engineering. Translate ambiguous clinical and commercial needs into crisp problem statements, prototypes, requirements and sequenced releases, then stay close through validation, launch and iteration.

 Build trust into the product. Partner with clinical, legal, privacy, security and quality so consent, traceability, explainability, role-based access, auditability and human review are designed in from the start.

 Make pragmatic integration and data calls across EHR/EMR, CTMS, EDC, eConsent, ePRO, trial registries, identity and communications systems.

 Measure outcomes, not output. Define the funnel metrics that matter: time to match, referral completeness, site response time, pre-screening effort, screen-failure rate, enrollment conversion, retention and user trust.

 You’d have sat in on screening visits at three research sites and come back with the two reasons coordinators still keep a paper eligibility checklist next to the CTMS.

 You’d have taken one sponsor’s protocol, turned its inclusion and exclusion criteria into a working pre-screening prototype, then watched a research nurse try to break it.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Browser Control Platform
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.

The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.

What you’ll do:
  • Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
  • Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover 
  • Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control. 
  • Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
  • Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer. 
Measured on:

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.

 Conditions Precedent und Conditions Subsequent steuerst du ebenso verlässlich wie Kreditverträge, Sicherheiten Pakete und Intercreditor Agreements gemeinsam mit Banken und externen Rechtsberatern.

 Dein Profil

 
 Du hast ein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches oder vergleichbares Studium abgeschlossen und verfügst über fünf bis zehn Jahre Erfahrung in Project Finance, Infrastructure Finance oder Transaction Advisory für erneuerbare Energien.

 Mehrere non-recourse Projektfinanzierungen hast du nachweislich hands-on von der Term-Sheet-Phase bis zum Financial Close strukturiert und erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

 CFADS, DSCR, LLCR, Debt Sculpting, Covenants, Cash Sweeps, Reserve Accounts sowie CP- und CS-Management beherrschst du fachlich sicher.

 LMA-basierte Kreditverträge, Sicherheitenpakete und Intercreditor Agreements kannst du verhandlungssicher beurteilen und gemeinsam mit Rechtsberatern zum Abschluss führen.

 Excel nutzt du auf Expertenniveau und baust komplexe Projektfinanzierungsmodelle selbstständig auf; Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen gehören zu deinem täglichen Handwerkszeug.

 Lender Due Diligence und externe Berater steuerst du souverän. Erfahrung mit BESS-Revenue-Streams, dem deutschen Regulierungsrahmen sowie M&A- oder Co-Investment-Strukturen ist ein starkes Plus.

 Du verbindest Ownership, Pragmatismus und Verhandlungsstärke mit sehr gutem Deutsch und Englisch auf Verhandlungsniveau. Für die enge Zusammenarbeit bist du regelmäßig an unserem Standort in Aschheim bei München präsent.

 
 Warum wir?

 
 Direkter Einfluss darauf, welche großen Batteriespeicherprojekte in Deutschland finanziert und gebaut werden.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
THE LAST FRONTIER 
 The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.
 
 ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.
 
 We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.
 
 Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.
 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and can bring order to multiple complex, multi-disciplinary hardware projects without slowing them down.
 
 You'll be responsible for planning, tracking, and de-risking delivery across products at varying stages of maturity - from early-TRL prototypes through to fielded, mission-ready systems - and from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Own project planning and delivery tracking across concurrent engineering projects and work streams (firmware, electronics, mechanical, testing), translating product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable projects with clear milestones, owners, and outcomes.

 Convert ambitious commercial and operational deadlines into realistic, resourced delivery plans — holding the line on both ambition and delivery discipline.

 Maintain visibility across work streams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps, managing technical risk and dependency mapping across products at different Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) and adjusting project rigour and testing requirements accordingly.

 Take ownership of BOMs for any existing and future products, manage key supplier relationships and keep track of all materials deliveries.

jobs.title: EMEA Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over one billion interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will drive global adoption of Parloa's AI agents by CX teams and contact centers, owning the positioning, launches, and sales enablement that bring our AI Agent Management Platform (Parloa AMP) to market. You will set how Parloa differentiates itself in a noisy AI agent market, translate our product roadmap into a story customers care about, and give sales the material they need to win.This is your opportunity to define the category narrative for enterprise AI agents at the exact moment the market is being formed.

Areas of ownership:

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Define positioning and messaging for Parloa products, orchestrate product communication plans, and drive cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Sales, and CX.
  • Product and Roadmap Alignment: Partner with Product and Engineering so the roadmap ladders up to the company narrative and GTM plan, and keep prospects, partners, and customers informed at every step.
  • Sales Enablement: Sharpen how Sales positions the platform through customer use cases, proof points, collateral, training sessions, and competitive differentiators built with our Enablement and Competitive Intelligence teams.
  • Market Awareness and Thought Leadership: Source content ideas, shape outlines, create and review content, and speak on webinars alongside our Content team, Evangelists, CX team, and executives.
  • Competitive Differentiation: Establish a deep understanding of the market, customers, and competition, then turn that insight into positioning that separates Parloa from the field.

Who you are:

  • 6+ years in Product Marketing, or 8+ years in adjacent roles working alongside a PMM team (sales enablement, B2B direct marketing).
  • Experience at an AI company or marketing AI products or capabilities.
  • An excellent writer with samples to prove it.
  • A proven track record supporting enterprise sales teams with storylines, collateral, enablement, and individual deal support.
  • A confident presenter who holds an audience on webinars, at company events, and in Sales training sessions.
  • Ambidextrous across strategy and tactics. You have crafted a product narratives and also built the sales deck from scratch, screenshots and all, when speed mattered more than polish.
  • You are experienced at using AI tools to help you be more creative, efficient, and productive.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
  • Pluses:
    • Experience with CX tools (contact center, customer service, digital experience software).
    • Business-fluent German is great, but not required.

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We’re a scale-up, having moved beyond our earliest startup phase. But we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Browser Control Platform
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.

The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.

What you’ll do:
  • Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
  • Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover 
  • Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control. 
  • Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
  • Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer. 
Measured on:

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.

What you'll bring:
  • A product-minded engineer, or a very technical PM who can drive a technical product 
  • Developer-space experience, with the range to think about consumers and internal platforms
  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguity; own a technical contract other teams depend on
  • Strong instincts on security and trust. Nice to have: web standards, MCP, browser automation

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
  

 Location 
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
  
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round

  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

At Staffbase, the search experience is one of the most strategically important problems we’re solving. Our stream is responsible for two deeply connected products: Hybrid Search — our next-generation search intelligence combining keyword and semantic search — and Navigator, the AI assistant that employees interact with directly.

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own Hybrid Search end-to-end: from our upcoming GA release through the next stage of expansion into enterprise-grade, multi-platform search intelligence. This is one of the top initiatives in the company, with high visibility to senior leadership and a meaningful impact on how millions of frontline employees find the information they need — whether they’re at a desk or on the go as a nurse, technician, or field worker.

This is a role for someone who finds depth and craft in growing and maturing a technically complex product, negotiating priorities with a senior engineering team, and continuously keeping the end user front and centre even when the work gets deeply technical.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the transition from GA release to the next phase — incorporating early customer feedback, defining what gets fixed vs. what gets expanded, and driving a clear prioritization call on roadmap direction
  • Establish the right success metrics for search: balancing technical performance signals with genuine user value
  • Work closely with the AI Assistant team to ensure search intelligence keeps pace with what the assistant surfaces
  • Expand search coverage: video subtitle indexing, richer content types, deeper platform integrations (SharePoint, Confluence, and beyond)
  • Build toward enterprise search: connecting Staffbase to the knowledge bases customers already use
  • Drive re-ranking improvements and relevance quality as the product matures
  • Help define what it means for an employee to find the right information, at the right time, from any device

What you need to be successful 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to search, information retrieval, or AI/ML-powered products

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
 
 What You'll Own 
 Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

 Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

 Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

 Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

 Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

 Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

 Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

  
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

 Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

 Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

 Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

 Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

 High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

  
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

 Can make decisions with incomplete information.

 Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

 Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

 Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

  
 This Role Is Not For 
 People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

 PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

 Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

 People who launch features and then stop caring.

 PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

  
 Location 
 This role is based in UK . This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our UK office at least 3 days per week.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Octopus Electroverse
jobs.description:
About Octopus Electroverse 

 We’re making electric vehicle public charging simple, by building the giant, virtual charging platform of the future. In just five years, Octopus Electroverse has become Europe’s largest eMobility charging network, with over 1.4 million connected electric vehicle chargers globally across 79 countries. Our customer ecosystem spans web, iOS, Android, CarPlay, Android Auto & Automotive OS. 

 But this is just the start: we’re busy expanding internationally, growing our Charge Point Operator and OEM partners, and scaling our Octopus Fleet B2B proposition - all in the name of making public EV charging super simple for our customers. Electroverse is a cross-functional team of product, engineering, commercial, operations and marketing, all sharing a passion for shifting the industry towards EVs. 

 About the Job 

 Electroverse operates as a relatively lean team, which means where we focus our energy really counts. Product and engineering make up roughly half of the business, reflecting how central technical execution is to our growth.

 This is primarily a leadership role grounded in deep product craft. While day-to-day feature execution and detailed roadmap planning are owned by our Product Managers, your focus is on high-level direction, organisational design, and cross-functional alignment; with the depth and credibility to dive into product details whenever necessary.

 What You’ll Do 
 

 
 Lead the Product team at Octopus Electroverse, overseeing B2C, B2B, and Licensing verticals across global markets, with cross-functional oversight of Design, Client Delivery, and Integration teams.

 
 Report directly to the Founder as part of the leadership team, working alongside department Heads and Directors to shape wider business strategy and execution

 
 Translate business strategy into a clear product vision, prioritising major investments and feature capabilities based on customer impact and commercial return.

 
 Work closely with engineering leads to turn overarching strategy into executable, high-impact product direction.

 
 Support high-performing squads by unblocking delivery, setting deep context, mitigating operational risk, and maintaining momentum.

 
 Design and evolve team structures as Electroverse scales, building career pathways and upskilling talent across the team.

 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with key external partners where occasionally required, for example with suppliers, vehicle OEMs, Charge Point Operators (CPOs), and enterprise B2B clients.

 
 Maintain oversight of key performance metrics, initiative progress, and operational execution for executive stakeholders.

 
 Stay ahead of product trends, tools, and methodologies, continuously reviewing and refining our operating approach.

 What You’ll Need 
 

 
 Proven track record leading high-performing teams, unblocking delivery, and coaching people to grow.

 
 Outstanding communicator who easily bridges high-level strategy and technical detail across all levels of the business.

 
 Experience in organisational design; building and scaling teams while maintaining clear ownership.

 
 Executive-level leadership experience, ready to take full accountability for your vertical and collaborate transparently with peers.

 
 Deep understanding of Product and Engineering operations (a pure Product background isn't essential if you bring strong technical and commercial leadership).

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager – Software Development (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission You are responsible for the operational management of our software development and ensure that our Backend and Frontend teams can deliver reliably and with clear focus. You manage planning, capacities, dependencies, and releases and keep the entire development process in view.
 You lead our Development Leads and development teams both functionally and disciplinarily. You establish clear responsibilities, develop team members, and ensure that problems and blockers are identified and resolved early.
 You coordinate teams and tickets throughout their full lifecycle, continuously improve our development and project processes, and ensure transparent and realistic planning for all relevant stakeholders.
 You are the central interface between Engineering and Product Management. Product owns product strategy, prioritization, and requirements; together with the Development Leads, you ensure these are translated into technically sound, realistically planned, and reliably delivered solutions.
 This is not a traditional IT project management role: you bring a strong technical background yourself and can make architecture and design decisions together with our Development Leads, assess technical risks, and evaluate different solution approaches.
 Alongside short-term delivery, you also keep long-term technical topics in view, including architecture, maintainability, security, technical debt, and the continuous improvement of our engineering standards.
 You actively drive our AI First Development Culture. This goes far beyond AI-assisted coding: you identify opportunities to integrate AI into research, technical conception, architecture, project planning, development, testing, reviews, debugging, documentation, and other development processes, and help the team use these tools effectively.
 

 Your profile You have at least 5 years of relevant professional experience in or around software development and have worked hands-on as a software developer yourself.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (Strategic Account Interactions) - Security Solutions
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role
 
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to be the primary product voice for Elastic Security's most strategic enterprise customers. Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems. They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas.
 
In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security's product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once. You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle. You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship. You will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering, building the structure that lets Elastic scale close customer relationships without simply adding headcount.
 
What You Will Be Doing
  • Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in “under consideration.”
  • Translate customer requirements into shipped products. Work at the level of customer pain, not just the feature that was asked for, and synthesize input from many accounts into a single, coherent product direction.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
  

 Location 
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round

About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. 
 We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. 

 About the team At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution. 

 Your mission You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities. 

 Responsibilities Translate Needs:  Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team. 

 Push the Backlog:  Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones. 

 Drive Execution:  Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly. 

 Document Capabilities:  Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver. 

 Evaluate & Accept Work:  Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines. 

 

 Qualifications Experience:  3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms. 

 Technical Literacy:  You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers. 

 Systems Thinking:  A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture. 

 Communication:  Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers. 

 

 Nice to have Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics. 

 Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration. 

 Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context. 

 Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors. 
 

 We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Region Delivery)
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to join our Region Delivery team. You will own the delivery of new compute regions end to end — from hardware handover through acceptance testing to production readiness — coordinating across hardware, networking, capacity, and platform engineering teams under tight timelines.

 

Your responsibilities will include

  • Owning delivery of region and GPU cluster deployment projects from kickoff through production handover

  • Coordinating the capacity acceptance procedure: validating infrastructure availability, quota allocations, monitoring/alerting, and documented sign-off before a region goes to customers

  • Coordinating acceptance testing across engineering teams (compute, storage, networking, GPU) and clarifying test ownership between them

  • Acting as the real-time escalation point during live deployments — resolving blockers such as hardware failures, provisioning issues, or capacity conflicts by engaging the right on-call teams

  • Defining and maintaining clear contracts and responsibilities between the teams involved in delivery to reduce cross-team ambiguity and friction

  • Driving continuous improvement and automation of repetitive deployment and acceptance-testing work

  • Running structured, high-signal status communications so stakeholders always know where a deployment stands

 

We expect you to have:

  • Proven experience leading technical projects or engineering teams, ideally in infrastructure, cloud, or datacenter environments

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across many engineering teams simultaneously and drive alignment without formal authority

  • Calm, decisive communication under pressure, including during live incidents

  • Strong bias toward clear ownership and documentation over ad hoc firefighting

  • Fluent English

 

It would be a strong advantage if you have:

  • Experience with cloud/compute capacity management or GPU infrastructure

  • Background in large-scale datacenter rollouts

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture<

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About us Since 2000,  ITA Logistics Group  has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms  LetMeShip  and  ParcelParcel , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service. 
 Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us. 

 Your mission As our (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d), you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our Customer APIs, the Unified Carrier Interface (UCI), and, going forward, the Unified Financial Platform (UFP) as well as our HubSpot integration. 
 You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving. 
 You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners. 

 Your Key Responsibilities You own and continuously develop the roadmap for our Customer APIs across LMS Enterprise and LMS Next. 

 You drive the migration of our API customers from LMS Enterprise to LMS Next, identifying and prioritizing the features and carrier integrations required to make the transition successful. 

 You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges. 

 You take ownership of the development of our Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. 

 You analyze requirements for carrier features and services, translate them into clear requirements for Engineering, and support QA in defining relevant test cases. 

 You communicate directly with our carriers to clarify technical requirements and integration specifics. 

 Once live, you take ownership of our Unified Financial Platform (UFP) and manage its backlog, requirements, and further development. 

 You continuously monitor our existing HubSpot integration and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback. 

 Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. 

 

 What you need to succeed You have a technical background, for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering. 

 You have experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally working with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations. 

 You have a solid understanding of APIs, API design, versioning, and migration strategies and feel confident engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineers.
 

 You are able to understand complex technical topics and translate them clearly for different audiences.
 

 You are confident in stakeholder management and know how to balance and prioritize competing technical and business needs.
 

 You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and adapting to changing priorities while keeping a clear overview of what matters most.
 

 You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and locations, including with colleagues in Hamburg and Naarden.
 

 You are curious about AI tools and digital solutions and enjoy exploring new ways to improve productivity, processes, and workflows.
 

 Experience in logistics, parcel, or freight tech, particularly with carrier API integrations, is a plus. 

 Familiarity with HubSpot or CRM integrations, as well as financial or invoicing systems and interfaces, is also a plus. 

 Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. 

 

 Why ITA Logistics Group? You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Verification squad sits at the heart of SumUp's ability to operate across 37 markets. We own the systems that determine whether a merchant's identity is verified, whether that verification meets the regulatory bar in every market we operate in, and whether the decisions made along the way are auditable and defensible. This isn't a coordination role — it's a high-ownership position where you'll set the product direction for a domain that is legally complex, strategically important, and actively transforming. If you want to own something that genuinely matters — where your decisions shape compliance outcomes, merchant experience, and platform capability simultaneously — this is that role.

What you'll do

  • Define and lead the product strategy for the verification platform, sequencing compliance obligations, platform modernisation, and merchant experience improvements with clear intent

  • Own the regulatory surface across multiple markets — monitoring evolving KYC/KYB, AML, and eIDAS requirements and converting them into structured, buildable scope before they become blockers

  • Make the hard calls where UX and backend decisions conflict, holding coherence across the full product surface and owning the outcome when trade-offs are required

  • Run lean, autonomous discovery — synthesising user research, data signals, and regulatory guidance into decision-ready artefacts independently

  • Co-lead the squad alongside a strong Engineering Manager, driving platform modernisation and reducing technical debt deliberately

You'll be great for this role if

  • Proven experience as a product manager in a regulated fintech or financial services environment, with direct ownership of KYC, KYB, or identity verification products across multiple markets

  • Strong ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder environments — including Legal, AML, Compliance, Risk, and Operations — negotiating scope with credibility and care, and holding the line when it matters

  • Technical depth to interrogate backend architecture decisions, API design trade-offs, and third-party vendor capabilities, and to make coherent product calls across the full stack

  • Data fluency: comfortable defining metrics, interrogating dashboards, and using quantitative signals to inform prioritisation and planning

  • Track record of arriving at planning conversations with evidence-backed proposals and the organisational confidence to defend them

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our modern Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup

  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

  • 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 and 10 paid days of educational leave which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

  • 🏖 Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

  • 🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

  • 💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities

  • 🍽 Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer (YouTrack)
jobs.description:
You see software development and team organization not as a rigid set of rules, but as a craft that deserves better tools. You want to design complex, data-rich productivity platforms where information architecture is a first-class problem, and you want to rethink how humans work alongside AI. If you are a designer who values hands-on craft, hates unnecessary bureaucracy, and wants the autonomy to build a team's design process from scratch, this role was built for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 companies rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

YouTrack handles serious complexity – agile boards, backlogs, knowledge bases, helpdesks, and deeply customizable workflows – across teams from two-person startups to global enterprises. We’re at a point where the category's oldest assumptions are worth reconsidering. Issue tracking has relied on the same foundational blocks for years, but AI opens an opportunity to rethink how software can actively help teams get work done.

We need a Lead Product Designer to shape where project management goes next while keeping a massive, mature surface area coherent, legible, and a pleasant to use. In this role, you’ll lead a small design team of two designers, own the overall design quality bar across the product, and act as an individual contributor on our hardest, least-charted problems. You’ll build a fresh design process from scratch with the full backing of a team lead who respects craft and values professional judgment.

Day to day, you will:

  • Shape a point of view on how project management and issue tracking evolve in an AI-native world and turn those concepts into tools people can actually use.
  • Design how people work alongside AI capabilities in YouTrack, from conversational interfaces to inline assistance and background automation.
  • Develop interaction patterns for unsettled problems, including surfacing AI confidence, making actions transparent, and keeping users in control.
  • Prototype and test new concepts quickly, separating ideas that feel clever from those that genuinely reduce friction.
  • Keep a large, deep product coherent so that boards, helpdesks, reports, and administration feel like a single cohesive engine.
  • Partner with product management and engineering to shape roadmap priorities from a design perspective, influencing what gets built and why.

What you’ll bring

  • A deep commitment to craft ownership, holding yourself and your team to high standards without creating bottlenecks.
  • Comfort building clear, lightweight processes, without turning them into restrictive bureaucracy.
  • The generosity to share knowledge openly and collaborate across a broad, global design community.
  • Clarity in your writing and reasoning, with the ability to explain complex design decisions in plain words.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy appetite for finding the right questions before designing the answers.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held, with a clear understanding of when to follow platform conventions and when to break them.

What you’ll need

  • Successfully led the design of complex, data-rich productivity tools or software systems where information architecture is a primary challenge.
  • Proven understanding of how modern AI systems operate beyond single-turn prompts, including agentic workflows and multi-step execution.
  • Experience mentoring and leading other designers, giving clear feedback that lands and raises the bar.
  • Ability to design unified experiences that cater to small startup teams and large enterprise customers simultaneously.
  • A portfolio showing a range of work from precise micro-interactions to large-scale information architecture.

What success looks like

Success means earning the trust of your team and peers through sound interaction choices and clear systemic improvements. You will establish a reliable critique rhythm and a structured way of working that helps your designers grow. Within your first few months, delivering clear patterns for our AI capabilities, paying down accumulated UX debt, and ensuring YouTrack remains both deep and remarkably quick on its feet.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge,
